alternatives.title: Cold-only measured source-qualified baseline
alternatives.hypothesis: Measure cold baseline, require exact source before considering warm state.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Simplifies authority and supports a deterministic comparison, but possible startup latency remains.

alternatives.title: Future host-local source-qualified warm reference reuse
alternatives.hypothesis: Study read-only, versioned host-local reference reuse after independent model/tenant/storage owner qualifications.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Could reduce cold load when truly source-equivalent; cost, deletion races and license changes remain unqualified.

alternatives.title: Read-only owner-issued M09 residency hint research
alternatives.hypothesis: Study provenance-bound M09 warm residency observations without granting, transferring, holding or changing any lease.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Could avoid misleading duplicate loads in a later admitted system; stale all-member and H01–H04 proofs absent.

alternatives.title: Future owner-qualified adaptive prefetch investigation
alternatives.hypothesis: Study possible future predictive per-model/locality policy constrained by actual M08 metrics and independently admitted M09/M11/M12/M54/M55/M60 contracts.
alternatives.tradeoffs: May reduce later cold latency, but unnecessary warming can harm interactive use, power/VRAM safety, rights and quality.

metrics.definition: Paired matched-run cold-start distribution with exact hardware/model/runtime/protocol context.
Separately measured warm-start distribution with preload and interference accounted.
Only hits whose version, tenant, rights, source and invalidation match, not raw key collisions.
Measured RAM/VRAM residency observations distinct from actual lease/grant.
Time/bytes from declared invalidations, deletion and safe reload as later qualified by owners.
Declared local read bytes/bandwidth and physical owner storage traces under an admitted protocol.
Record interactive latency, concurrent pressure and UNKNOWN when telemetry absent.
Independent fidelity and master validation of equivalent outputs; no quality decision in M13.
Track avoided/unused loads and owner-qualified evictions with complete provenance.
Compare only exact compatible protocols, noise guards and hardware/runtime qualification.

questions.question: Which exact accepted M02 work/revision and immutable M06 operational identity can a warm-cache key reference without treating matching bytes as accepted semantic production state?
Which genuinely owner-qualified model source, weights digest, license, variant and trusted package provenance must match before a local cached model could be considered for reuse?
Which exact M07 device, runtime, software and topology evidence invalidates a prior device-specific warm or compiled-cache observation when hardware or drivers materially change?
Which M08 benchmark protocol, clock, sample size, noise and hardware-binding evidence can support comparable cold-versus-warm measurements without manufacturing GPU results?
How can a cache observation reference M09 residency and resource truth without inventing a new lease, reservation, fresh capacity or ownership of device memory?
Which future exact request, owner liveness, coherent all-member lease and at-use epoch/revocation proofs would have to precede any positive GPU prewarming action?
What independently approved tenant, project, principal and physical-storage boundaries must partition cache keys even when two callers reference identical source bytes?
Who may own physical cache retention, eviction, disk quotas, archive and deletion receipts, and how can M13 avoid becoming a second M55 storage authority?
Which M01 Fidelity Contract and independently evaluated quality gates make it impermissible for a fast cache hit to bypass output validation or promote a draft as a final master?
What exact owner-issued consent, model/media rights, license version and revocation evidence must invalidate reuse before a cached source or derivative can cross its allowed scope?
What separately reviewed model, compiler, attention kernel, backend, custom-node and provider-version identities define compatibility for any future compiled-cache artifact?
How may frozen advisory M10 plan hints and still-unfrozen M12 placement candidates inform documentary locality comparison without selecting a runtime worker or resource grant?
Which versioned observed cold/warm hit, latency, loading-time, I/O and memory-attribution metrics with uncertainty are publishable without treating claimed hit rate as real speedup?
What independently qualified host OS, device/process instance and isolation proofs would be necessary before a future local warm residency observation became safe across worker restarts?
What does a worker exit, heartbeat loss, stale process identifier or missing independent ACK do to previously cached state references, without authorizing termination or capacity reclamation?
When must stochastic generation, changed semantic graph, operational revision or non-deterministic provider behavior prohibit output or intermediate reuse despite an identical digest?
What source-backed deletion, key revocation and tenant-isolated eviction evidence proves that a warmed artifact cannot be reused after its authorization is withdrawn?

Which future measurement methodology separates actual performance gain from quality loss, thermal throttling, cache interference and uncontrolled workload variance without selecting numeric production gates?

negativeScenarios.trigger: A second tenant claims identical content hashes and requests reuse of another tenant's warm weights or metadata.
A cached intermediate has the same bytes but belongs to a different accepted M02 semantic revision or M06 operational attempt.
A cached model or compiled kernel claims an obsolete model/package/license or mismatched backend/custom-node version.
A warm GPU descriptor has stale M09 snapshot/lease or one revoked member while other device observations remain current.
An old cached worker identifier is reused after process exit, node reboot or lost authenticated ACK.
M55 deletion or M54 credential/tenant revocation occurs while M13 still holds an apparent reusable entry.
A valid local cache hit produces a draft that lacks independent M01 quality verification or has changed creative constraints.
A synthetic, incompatible or stale M08 cold/warm benchmark is cited as observed production GPU speedup.
A future planner treats unused cached bytes or advisory M10 predicted locality as actual granted M09 capacity.
License scope, consent or media/model export approval is revoked after a local model bundle is cached.
Hardware driver/accelerator/runtime fingerprint materially changes while an old device-compiled cache remains present.
A claimed warm result is faster only because interactive foreground work was preempted or output fidelity silently lowered.
